title: bassline swap
system_instruction_addendum: BASSLINE SWAP ADDENDUM: The kick belongs to one deck at a time. Cut deck a's lows then raise deck b's lows on the beat-1 of a phrase. Two basslines stacking is the train wreck this lesson prevents.

tutor_speak.text: two kicks at once is the sound of a train wreck. the bassline swap moves the low end from one deck to the other in a single beat.
on the next beat one, swap deck b's low knob from zero to full while you drop deck a's low knob to zero.

hints.text: the swap happens in one motion: both knobs cross at the same moment.
wait for the kick on beat one, then move both knobs.
raise deck b's low knob to full on the next beat one.
